name: memhop-profile
summary: L0 profile manual: read/update the host identity profile (role, personality, preferences, lexicon, style traits, emotion patterns)
trigger: need to view or adjust the host profile, identity, preferences; profile l0 identity role preference personality lexicon

resources.name: GetL0
resources.desc: Read the current L0 profile; returns Name/Role/Personality/Preferences/Lexicon/StyleTraits/EmotionPatterns

resources.name: UpdateL0
resources.desc: Replace the L0 profile wholesale (full overwrite); omitted fields are cleared, so GetL0 first and fill values back; Preferences/Lexicon/EmotionPatterns are key-value maps, StyleTraits is a string list

steps.action: Read current values when profile info is needed or before updating
Overwrite the profile with fully filled-back values
